title: Turn toward the sun
hook: Orientation can change how much surface faces light.

knows: Animals have body structures and interact with their surroundings.
doesNotKnow: The first panel presents a broad surface to the illustrated rays; the second is nearly edge-on. Some lizards can alter exposure by orientation, but real heat gain also depends on radiation, shape and conditions.

misconception: The observed arrangement has a different effect than the one shown.
objective: A flat surface is compared face-on and edge-on to incoming rays. Which orientation presents the larger area?
